messages:
Olivia: Heads up — console alert: hourly aggregates showing ~2.3k keys with missing counts for the 03:00–04:00 window. Likely late events after a Kafka rebalance. :eyes:
Dmitri: link: https://console.redwood/telemetry/agg-hours?window=03-04 — I can repro the gaps on the shard heatmap.
Sam: can we do a targeted rehydrate for only the affected key-range? global backfill is expensive.
Kate: +1 on targeted. but we need to estimate quota/cost before we kick it. last time a small replay bumped us into reserved quota.
Olivia: I pulled the list of affected tenant_ids. small sample: `['t_482','t_901','t_77']` — full extraction under /tmp/late-03-04.tsv.
Olivia: SQL I ran to detect keys (paste):
```
SELECT tenant_id, shard, count(*) as missing_rows
FROM telemetry.hourly_agg
WHERE hour='2026-03-14T03:00:00Z' AND updated_at > '2026-03-14T04:00:00Z' AND value IS NULL
GROUP BY tenant_id, shard
ORDER BY missing_rows DESC
LIMIT 5000;
```
Dmitri: nice. I think we should: 1) mark those shards for a 'mini-rehydrate' job, 2) run on background priority with low concurrency, 3) track console progress.
Ryan: propose API param for reprocess endpoint: `priority=background&quota_tag=mini_rehyd_2026_03_14&max_concurrency=4` — avoids jump into high-priority lanes.
Sam: can we add a dry-run first? show estimated row count + token cost in the console before submit. current console only shows job name.
Kate: UX ask: add an 'estimate' step in the rehydrate modal + checkbox to opt into reserved quota if owner wants faster turnaround.
Olivia: agree. immediate plan: run a dry-run on 2 shards to validate idempotency and runtime. if good, roll small batches.
Sam: command I'm going to run (dry-run):
```
infra rehydrate --shard 12,13 --window 2026-03-14T03:00:00Z --dry-run --max-concurrency 2 --priority background
```
ops-bot: Job queued: rehydrate-dryrun-1759876543-01 (owner: Sam). ETA: ~2m.
Dmitri: if dry-run looks clean, we should annotate affected tenants and add a temporary console flag `exclude_from_slo` so alerts don't keep firing during the rehydrate.
Kate: make sure we don't hide the underlying problem. alerts should downgrade to INFO but still capture original counts.
Ryan: long-term: we should have routing policy that sends replay work to a separate 'rehyd' fleet with isolated quota. reduces noisy neighbor risk. filing RFC? @Dmitri @Olivia
Dmitri: filing RFC after this hotfix. intention: route low-priority replays to spot-capacity Dedicated pool with pre-defined cost caps.
Olivia: quick note: add a tag on the job `replay_cause=kafka-rebalance` so we can filter regressions in the next week.
Sam: dry-run finished. ops-bot: rehydrate-dryrun-1759876543-01 completed (0 failures). estimate: 2.1k rows, expected full-run time ~8m at concurrency=2.
Olivia: looks good. starting the first real batch with `max_concurrency=3` and rate-limit to 5qps per-shard.
Sam: kicking it now: `infra rehydrate --shard 12,13,14 --window 2026-03-14T03:00:00Z --max-concurrency 3 --rate 5qps --priority background --tag kafka-rebalance`
ops-bot: Job started: rehydrate-1759876543-02 (shards: 12,13,14). Progress: 0/2100 rows.
console-bot: Alert update: hourly-agg-stale alert downgraded to INFO for window 03:00–04:00 while rehydrate job active.
Kate: monitoring cost dashboard. current rate impact looks negligible. thanks for the dry-run. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: fyi — putting a small note on the console UX backlog: estimate step + quota preview + 'run-as-background' toggle.
Ryan: and I'll draft the RFC for replay routing and budget pools this afternoon.
Olivia: thanks all. we'll keep this thread for postmortem notes (duration, rows rehydrated, any duplicates). please add any anomalies here.
Sam: postmortem note: observed a 3% delta in a couple tenants after rehydrate — investigating whether late-ordering or duplicate ingestion fixed it.
Dmitri: recording final numbers: rows rehydrated 2103, runtime 7m42s, peak concurrency 3, failures 0. job closed.
Olivia: closing alert now. will follow up with small RFC link when available.
Ryan: RFC created: https://go.redwood/rfcs/replay-routing-mini — ping for review.
Olivia: thanks everyone.
